scene_analysis.scene_overview: A city street with tall buildings on both sides, lined with parked motorcycles and trees, and featuring a mix of commercial and residential properties. The street is relatively empty, with only a few pedestrians and motorcyclists present. The sky is clear and blue, suggesting a sunny day.
scene_analysis.buildings: Left building: A large, multi-story structure with a modern glass façade and balconies on each floor. Right building: An older, more ornate structure with arched windows and decorative details.
scene_analysis.materials: Left building: The exterior walls are made of a combination of concrete and glass, while the right building has a stone façade with intricate carvings and ornate details.
scene_analysis.street_furniture: Left building: Several benches and planters line the sidewalk, providing shade and seating areas for pedestrians. Right building: A few tables and chairs are set up outside a café, inviting passersby to stop and rest.
scene_analysis.vegetation: Left building: Several trees and shrubs are planted along the sidewalk, adding a touch of greenery to the urban landscape. Right building: A small garden bed filled with flowers and plants adds color and texture to the scene.
scene_analysis.as_resident: Left building: People seem to be enjoying the warm weather, with some wearing short sleeves and shorts. Right building: People are dressed in layers, with some wearing jackets and hats.
scene_analysis.as_tourist: Left building: Tourists are taking photos and admiring the architecture. Right building: Tourists are exploring the area, looking at maps and guides.
scene_analysis.as_student: Left building: Students are milling about, taking notes and chatting. Right building: Students are studying, working on assignments, or simply hanging out.
